prelaunch: Require fresh shared budget and total reservation headroom, no active duplicate, absent output root, matching published GitHub revision and all pinned source/input hashes. A partial file or failed prior attempt counts as the one attempt and must not be silently restarted.
publication_rule: Record projection stdout/stderr, exit status, wall time, output byte count and SHA-256. Publish its exact hash before invoking the selective rebase. No certificate acceptance from projection alone.
